tools.name: geolocate_image
tools.description: Analyze an image and return its probable real-world location. Returns ranked coordinates with a confidence score and the visual evidence chain the analysis used (architecture, signage, vegetation, terrain, lighting). No EXIF or GPS required. Capped at 20 analyses an hour across all Oceanir analysis

tools.name: verify_location_claim
tools.description: Test whether an image is consistent with a location someone has already claimed: a listing's stated city, an address on a case file or claim form, a caption. Oceanir locates the image from visual evidence alone FIRST, then compares. Returns a verdict of `agrees`, `contradicts`, or `unverifiable`, wi

tools.name: check_credits
tools.description: Check the authenticated Oceanir account's current credit balance and remaining monthly allowance.

tools.name: list_analyses
tools.description: List this account's past Oceanir results, newest first: place, coordinates, confidence, depth and date. Read-only: it never runs a new analysis and never spends credits. Use it to find an earlier result instead of analyzing the same image again. Accounts with analysis history switched off return not

tools.name: list_cases
tools.description: List this account's cases (named groups of results), newest first, with their ids. Read-only: it never runs an analysis and never spends credits. Use the returned id with get_case_summary or analyze_case_image.

tools.name: get_case_summary
tools.description: Read a case's summary: what it holds, the results attached to it and where they point. Read-only: it never runs an analysis and never spends credits. Reads the scene only (architecture, signage, terrain, vegetation), never the people in it. No face recognition, no biometric identification, no person

tools.name: create_case
tools.description: Create an empty case to group related results. Free: it spends no credits. Returns the case id to pass to analyze_case_image.

tools.name: analyze_case_image
tools.description: Analyze one image and attach the result to an existing case. Spends credits (D1 1, D2 2, D3 10) exactly like geolocate_image. tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Read the last 30 days of Oceanir usage for the authenticated account: calls, credits used, a breakdown by depth, and what remains. Read-only; it never spends credits.
